args.question:
Cobalt Labs (V-222) has two approved invoices, and you asked me to pay "the approved invoice." Which one should I pay by wire from the operating account?
1) INV-34905: $5,983.10, due 2026-11-04
2) INV-36824: $1,652.34, due 2026-11-25
(Also on file but not eligible: INV-72843, $7,093.97, still in draft awaiting approval; INV-47379, $3,033.57, already paid.)
Reply with the invoice ID and I'll send the wire for the full amount, once only.
